admission.justification: The obligation's realizations in more than one file are what its statement binds together.

applicability: The Knowledge page's own tree, Markdown renderer and code view.
conditions: They are removed in favour of the dashboard's shared `ExplorerTree`, `Markdown` and `FilePane`.
No second copy of any of them is left behind.
exclusions: A shared primitive the page cannot use without changing its other consumers.
statement: Knowledge has one shared tree, Markdown renderer and code primitive instead of its former private renderers.
